justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/AuthenticationHandler.java and src/main/java11/org/jsoup/helper/RequestAuthHandler.java. AuthShim is only a 3-method nested interface (enable, remove, get) with no state, and its two implementations are small adapters for Java 8 global Authenticator vs Java 9+ per-request auth. The code shows a narrow bridge abstraction rather than a class with multiple responsibilities or excessive internal decomposition needs.
